schema.text: Which of the two points on the map is the right one?
schema.help: This tells us which point to keep, so the service appears on the map only once.

en.#Which of the two points on the map is t: Which of the two points on the map is the right one?
en.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: This tells us which point to keep, so the service appears on the map only once.

it.#Which of the two points on the map is t: Quale dei due punti sulla mappa è quello giusto?
it.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: Ci dice quale punto tenere, così il servizio compare sulla mappa una volta sola.

fr.#Which of the two points on the map is t: Lequel des deux points de la carte est le bon ?
fr.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: Cela nous indique quel point conserver, pour que le service n’apparaisse qu’une seule fois sur la carte.

de.#Which of the two points on the map is t: Welcher der beiden Punkte auf der Karte ist der richtige?
de.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: Das zeigt uns, welcher Punkt bleiben soll, damit die Einrichtung nur einmal auf der Karte erscheint.

tr.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: Bu, hangi noktanın kalacağını bize söyler; böylece hizmet haritada yalnızca bir kez görünür.

fa.#Which of the two points on the map is t: کدام‌یک از دو نقطه‌ی روی نقشه درست است؟
fa.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: این به ما می‌گوید کدام نقطه بماند تا این خدمت فقط یک بار روی نقشه دیده شود.

hu.#Which of the two points on the map is t: A térkép két pontja közül melyik a helyes?
hu.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: Ez megmutatja, melyik pontot tartsuk meg, hogy a szolgáltatás csak egyszer szerepeljen a térképen.

ar.#Which of the two points on the map is t: أيّ النقطتين على الخريطة هي الصحيحة؟
ar.#This tells us which point to keep, so t: يخبرنا هذا بالنقطة التي يجب الإبقاء عليها، لتظهر الخدمة مرة واحدة فقط على الخريطة.
